text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The best way t'get in shape is by rethink'n your
diet. If I eat some more wild veggies, I should be
okay!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Although... they're not 'xactly popp'n outta the
ground everywhere like they are back home...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's no reason t'give up! I just gotta
look harder!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! I've found some! Time t'get pick'n! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I betcha there's a bunch more 'round here too...
Okay! The search is on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uf. Bueno, resulta que hay montones si te pones a
buscar. ¡Y ahora estoy lista para preparar un
banquete con estas verduras silvestres!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...¡Vaya! ¡Se hizo de noche sin darme cuenta!
¡Tengo que volver rápido!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tras recolectar verduras silvestres, Yukino Bijin
prepara platos saludables y recupera su salud por
completo.
